places: Ponta do Pico (Pico or Pico Alto) on Ilha do Pico in the Azores

fields.climate: maritime temperate; cool and rainy in north, warmer and drier in south
fields.terrain: the west-flowing Tagus River divides the country: the north is mountainous toward the interior, while the south is characterized by rolling plains
fields.hazards: Azores subject to severe earthquakes; volcanism: limited volcanic activity in the Azores Islands; Fayal or Faial (1,043 m) last erupted in 1958; most volcanoes have not erupted in centuries…
fields.resources: fish, forests (cork), iron ore, copper, zinc, tin, tungsten, silver, gold, uranium, marble, clay, gypsum, salt, arable land, hydropower
fields.farm: milk, tomatoes, olives, grapes, maize, pork, potatoes, chicken, apples, oranges
fields.exports: cars, garments, vehicle parts/accessories, unpackaged medicine, refined petroleum
fields.industries: textiles, clothing, footwear, wood and cork, paper and pulp, chemicals, fuels and lubricants, automobiles and auto parts, base metals, minerals, porcelain and ceramics, glassware, technology…
fields.religions: Catholic 68.1%, not applicable 12.9%, no religion 12.0%, no response 2.2%, Protestant 1.8%, other 1.0%; less than 1%: other Christians, Orthodox, Muslim
fields.legal: civil law system; Constitutional Court reviews legislative acts
fields.military: 18-30 years of age for voluntary or contract military service for men and women (upper age limit varies by military branch, position, role)…
